title: Plasma Computer Logic (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Bits are waves, interference, and solitons — a transistor-free logic family. The Signature extension defines a complete plasma instruction set: wave-AND, soliton-SHIFT, vortex-NOT, and density-STORE as machine primitives compiled from ordinary code. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.

Mirrors its public twin record: AND, OR, and NOT fall out of wave interference with a bias wave setting the gate type. The Signature extension makes gates reconfigurable: the bias wave's phase is set per operation, so the same cell is an AND gate one cycle and an OR gate the next. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
